recipe.title: High-Protein Breakfast Quesadilla
recipe.summary: A crisp breakfast quesadilla stuffed with eggs, chicken sausage, cottage cheese, and cheddar for approximately 44 grams of protein and 395 calories.
recipe.story: This is the kind of breakfast that actually holds you until lunch. Blended cottage cheese makes the eggs creamy, while chicken sausage and a crisp tortilla make it feel like a real breakfast instead of a sad little protein project.
ingredients: 1/2 cup Simple Truth Organic Cage Free 100% Liquid Egg Whites
2 Amylu Chicken Breakfast Sausage Links from the Costco club pack, chopped
1 Mission Carb Balance Soft Taco Flour Tortilla
Pinch of salt and black pepper
instructions: Blend the egg, egg whites, cottage cheese, garlic powder, salt, and pepper until mostly smooth.
Coat a nonstick skillet with cooking spray and place it over medium heat.
Add the chopped chicken sausage and cook for 2 minutes, until warmed and lightly browned.
Pour in the egg mixture and gently scramble until just set, 3 to 4 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Place the tortilla in the skillet. Spoon the egg and sausage mixture over one half, sprinkle with cheddar, and fold the tortilla over.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until crisp and the cheese has melted.
Rest for 1 minute, then cut into three wedges.
tips: Keep the heat at medium so the tortilla crisps without burning.
The filling can be made the night before and reheated before assembling.
Nutrition is approximate and varies by sausage, tortilla, cottage cheese, and cheddar brand.
